# History rewrite 2026-10

Date: 2026-10-28 (rewrite), published 2026-10-29.

## Why

Published history contained two kinds of material that had to be removed, not
just deleted at the tip:

1. A host environment block captured in an interop evidence artifact
   (`docs/release-evidence/19acc308ab01a789a831a49aa9cf98afc50eefd4/chromium-native-interop.json`,
   added in old `35b4e5f5`, sanitized at the tip in old `df639bbf`). It held a live
   `LOKALISE_API_TOKEN`, an `OLLAMA_API_KEY`, and session identifiers
   (`STARSHIP_SESSION_KEY`, `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`, `CURSOR_CONVERSATION_ID`). Both
   credentials have been rotated. See `docs/SECURITY_REMEDIATION_FOLLOWUP_2026-07-31.md`.
2. Agent/session tooling artifacts committed in old `98129132` and untracked in
   old `5a23d999`: Codex conversation transcripts (`.mempalace/`), a code-index
   database (`.chunkhound/`), and assorted agent state and editor config.
   `.investigation/` scratch data existed only on a since-deleted probe branch.

## What was done

Tool: git-filter-repo 2.47.0 on a mirror; the pre-rewrite state is preserved
in an offline bundle held by the maintainer.

```
git filter-repo --force --invert-paths --paths-from-file purge-paths.txt \
  --replace-text expressions.txt \
  --refs <refs containing affected commits> \
  ^32efbcb6a64865b1bbc2b43c6be8b6b994722e41 \
  ^3887c3db470f7d42e78994fddf5371829426d38b \
  ^ca7a4a4f392e1d724f149100762c3b67ff02b950
```

`expressions.txt` replaced the token value and the session-identifier values
with `***REMOVED***` (values intentionally not reproduced here). The rewrite
was limited to descendants of the affected commits, so no unaffected commit
changed and no commit signature was stripped.

Purged paths (from every commit):

- `.mempalace/`
- `.chunkhound/`
- `.chunkhound.json`
- `.omc/`
- `.codex/`
- `.mcp.json`
- `.zed/`
- `mempalace.yaml`
- `entities.json`
- `memory/`
- `scripts/mempal-sync-codex-convos.sh`
- `.investigation/`

Unchanged by the rewrite: `main` before the merge of this branch
(`d601d7258937970ef6760e3fe50263385d30168a`), `development`,
`bench-workflow-registration`, and tags `v0.1.0` through `v0.3.0`.

Stale remote branches and the `functional-cert-*` tags that carried the
affected history were deleted rather than republished.

## Commit SHAs cited in this repository

Docs, research notes, stamps, `docs/release-status.json`, release-evidence
directory names and evidence ids cite pre-rewrite SHAs. They were deliberately
not rewritten; release evidence will be regenerated at a new candidate.
Resolve any cited pre-rewrite SHA (full or abbreviated) with the map below.
Tree contents are identical between each old commit and its new commit except
for the purged paths and redacted values.

Key mappings:

- old `rebind4-staging` tip `1298196fd25b4f4743de4411929a7954f90f4f72` -> `53485791fda927069d71297ad708feb518577471`
- old release-status candidate `875dfbfe736056326a64532fdfe6ced702a19aa2` -> `dc635e4608a0cb91eb2336da1f08d56c236bff0d`
